newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls sharply but stable.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls sharply but stable.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell sharply on Thursday on news of campaign-related violence in Jakarta but stabilised at lower levels, dealers said.
They said the rupiah was stable at 2,442.0/43.0 against the dollar at 1000 GMT against an opening of 2,433.0/34.0.
"The tone remains biddish on the dollar although the market has quietened down for now," one local bank dealer said.
The rupiah earlier had found support at the 2,338 and 2,339 levels after being jolted by a spill-over from weakness in the Thai baht and jitters over the ongoing general election campaign.
